options: Arrange clear spaces and assign each learner a role
Add more learners to the same small space
questions.correctAnswer: Arrange clear spaces and assign each learner a role
questions.explanation: Clear spacing and defined roles make a group performance safer and easier to follow.
questions.learningOutcome: Improve an integrated creative arts performance for clarity and safety.
